name: Hyunae Park — greeting avatar (cardigan)
mesh: Body: Higgsfield (Meshy 7 image-to-3D, standard mode, textured, auto-rigged) from a full-body reference image. Head: a second Meshy 7 reconstruction from a head-and-shoulders image made from the site owner's own portrait photo, scaled and placed on the body by eye and mouth landmarks with scripts/avatar/attach-head.py; the old head is removed, the new one follows the Head bone, and the body's skin tone is matched to it. Photos supplied by her for this purpose. The same script flattens and narrows the chest, and moves the front of the chest from the arm bones to the spine so it keeps its shape when an arm moves. Two liner bands inside the neck join (skin under the collar, black knit behind it) close the gaps the join left.
animation: Intro, 10 s at 24 fps, authored procedurally in scripts/build-avatar-intro.py: typing with her back turned, swivel, wave, bow. The generated clip that shipped with the rig is discarded.
placement: Shares the desk scene's coordinates (metres, desk top at z = 0) so the page can layer it over assets/hyunae-mac-studio.glb with the same camera.
page: assets/portfolio-studio.js plays it once, then fades the layer out and removes it. Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.
